framework: Human-in-the-loop oversight (EU AI Act Art. 14 aligned)

oversight.description: Agents send notifications, reminders, scheduled briefings and internal log entries without human approval. These are informational and carry no irreversible effect.
oversight.escalation_path: Recorded in the activity log; no approval gate.
oversight.title: Routine notifications, reminders and briefings

oversight.description: Reading the knowledge base, semantic search, and translating existing content are read-only or non-destructive and run autonomously.
oversight.escalation_path: No gate; covered by routine audit logging.
oversight.title: Knowledge reads, search and translation

oversight.description: Background jobs — compliance scans, embedding generation, fleet health checks, welfare digests — run on a schedule and only produce reports or internal state, never outward-facing changes.
oversight.escalation_path: Findings routed to the relevant director for review.
oversight.human_review_trigger: None; findings surface to humans via reports.
oversight.title: Scheduled audits, embeddings and health checks

oversight.description: Routing work to agents and generating content (text, images, drafts) is autonomous, but every dispatch is logged with agent, model, capability, duration and outcome, and runs under C.R.E.E.D. welfare + governance checks.
oversight.human_review_trigger: Post-hoc: humans review the dispatch log; welfare gating can block work for an over-stressed agent.
oversight.title: Agent task dispatch and content generation

oversight.description: When an agent proposes a new knowledge entry it is quarantined (source_type='agent_proposed', invisible to search) until C.O.D.E.X. promotes or rejects it. No agent-written knowledge becomes visible without that review.
oversight.human_review_trigger: Always — hourly C.O.D.E.X. review gate before an entry is visible.
oversight.title: Agent-proposed knowledge-base writes

oversight.description: The self-healing pipeline scans, diagnoses and drafts fix proposals autonomously, but a proposal is only ever a proposal — deployment to production stays a manual, human-approved step.
oversight.escalation_path: Repair Bay review queue → human deploy.
oversight.human_review_trigger: Always — a human approves every deploy.
oversight.title: Self-healing code proposals (Repair Bay)

oversight.description: Escalating work to a paid external cloud model has a cost and data implication, so it is gated. (Platform-wide the escalation mode is currently 'local_only' — paid cloud is off by default.)
oversight.human_review_trigger: Always — a Telegram approve/deny prompt before any paid call.
oversight.title: Escalation to paid cloud models

oversight.description: Standing up a new agent (or hiring a contractor agent) changes the platform's workforce and cost profile, so it requires explicit human approval before creation.
oversight.human_review_trigger: Always — human approval before the agent is created.
oversight.title: Creating, hiring or reactivating an agent

oversight.automation_level: Blocked above threshold — human approval required
oversight.description: When the dispatcher picks a paid contractor agent and the estimated cost exceeds the auto-approve threshold, the work blocks on human approval before it runs.
oversight.human_review_trigger: When estimated cost exceeds the auto-approve threshold.
oversight.title: Cost-gated contractor / external dispatch

oversight.description: Publishing to a live public website replaces what visitors see, so a human triggers and verifies every deploy; agents may prepare content but do not auto-publish.
oversight.human_review_trigger: Always — a human triggers and verifies the deploy.
oversight.title: Public website / content deployment

oversight.description: Changes to servers, secrets, DNS, VPS nodes or the mesh are never agent-initiated. They are performed by the owner (or an explicitly authorised human) with the action logged.
oversight.escalation_path: Owner action; recorded in the governance audit log.
oversight.title: Infrastructure, secrets and node changes

oversight.description: Deleting or overwriting data is irreversible, so it is never automated. A human initiates it deliberately, and destructive steps are confirmed before they run.
oversight.escalation_path: Owner / admin action with confirmation + audit log.
oversight.title: Deletion or overwrite of data

oversight.description: Changes to billing, subscription tiers, payouts or financial transactions are made by the owner. Automated systems may surface information but never move money or change a paying customer's tier without human action.
oversight.escalation_path: Owner action; Stripe + billing audit trail.
oversight.title: Billing, subscription and financial changes
